title: Causal Chain: From Benchmark Performance to National Security Risk — Identifying the Missing Link

original_idea.body:
# Causal Chain: From Benchmark Performance to National Security Risk — Identifying the Missing Link

**Problem:** Anthropic's gray zone claim is that ASL-4 represents 'clean rule-out of elevated national security risk is difficult'. The causal path from model capability → national security risk is never explicitly specified in governance documents.

**Direction:** Extract all national security risk claims from Anthropic RSP, OpenAI Preparedness Framework, NIST AI 800-1, and Bengio et al. 2026. For each claim, map the assumed causal chain from AI capability to national security harm. Identify missing causal links. Rate each claim's empirical support.

**Why it matters:** Governance thresholds keyed to national security risk are only meaningful if the causal pathway to that risk is specified and validated. Missing causal links mean thresholds are defined relative to an assumed but unvalidated threat model.

**Relevant context:** Anthropic gray zone and ASL-4 national security language; DOD Anthropic national security risk claim (TechCrunch Mar 2026); Bengio et al. 2026.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain but connection between benchmark and safety impact needs clarification.
